item.subject: science
item.stem: Rohan and his classmates in a school in Pune notice changes such as increased height, broader shoulders, pimples, a hoarse voice, and new body hair during adolescence. Which statement about these changes is correct?

options.A: Every student in the class must show the same changes at exactly the same age.
options.B: These are normal adolescent changes, but their timing and extent vary from person to person.
options.C: Pimples and a hoarse voice are signs of a disease and are not normal changes.
options.D: A student whose voice changes later than classmates is developing abnormally.
